builtin.description: Puppeteer's own data, as {tools} tools: notes, todos, past sessions (search and read), projects and repos, the project's file tree and git, Slack threads the app saved, the Skills and Rules library, managed VPS and cloud accounts, dev servers, the code index, and schedule proposals.
builtin.purpose: Lets the AI use what you keep in Puppeteer without pasting it into the prompt: recall an earlier session, write a note or todo, look up a rule, run a command on a managed server.
builtin.googleDescription: Drive (drive_*): list, search, read, upload, share, delete files. Sheets (sheets_*): read any tab, edit individual cells, append rows. Gmail (mail_*): search, read, attachments, send, reply, labels. Calendar (cal_*): view events, check free slots, create and update meetings — as {tools} tools.
builtin.googlePurpose: Lets the AI work with your Google Drive, Sheets, Gmail and Calendar through the accounts you connect. Off by default because it reaches your mail and files: it is injected only once you switch it on and connect at least one Google account (Google settings).
